title: Style bible
description: One per project (bibles/style.json): format and the look string every compiled prompt ends with.

look.description: Verbatim style string: medium, palette, light, lens, grain.

lens_family.description: Lens kind and range, e.g. 'spherical zooms, 25-250mm'. The continuity diff warns LENS when a card's lens_mm falls outside every NN-NNmm range named.

frame_aspect.description: Aspect the film is composed and delivered in when it differs from the rendered aspect_ratio, e.g. 2.39:1 inside a 16:9 render. Compiled as a composition sentence; the crop happens in finishing.

lighting.description: Verbatim lighting string for the whole film: key style, contrast and color temperature in words. Compiled after the look string in every prompt.

allowed_moves.description: Camera moves the style permits; the continuity diff warns MOVE on any other.

history.description: Ids of the cinewright-history style cards the look was built from (provenance; the compiler reads the fields, not the cards).
